The registration of the said FIR is at the instance of the respondent no. 2-Roshan Bibi wife of Ashiq Ali.

sentences.text: The tone and tenor of the allegations made in the FIR, prima facie, does not make any sense as to what is the actual accusation of the complainant/respondent no. 2 herein not only against the petitioner but even against her own brothers whom she has accused of subjecting her to physical beating so as to force her to go back to her matrimonial household.
However, it is only the petitioner who has been named as accused no. 1 in the impugned FIR.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner refers to the fact that a narrative set up in the impugned FIR does not give any time frame as to when the complainant/respondent no. 2 came to be subjected to the alleged commission of offences and the story is an open ended.
6. Prime facie case is made out.

7. Issue notice to the respondents in the main petition as also in application, returnable within four weeks.
8.
Petitioner to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the respondents within seven days whereupon Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notice to the respondents.

9. List again on 17.05.2024 along with Bail App No. 71/2024.
10.
In the meantime, it is ordered that further investigation in the impugned FIR to remain on hold till next date of hearing.
This direction is, however, subject to objections from other side.
